title: 第二千六百六十章 属于天之道的刀玩家们的分流第二千六百五十九章 画风突变的新年庆典
content_zh:
圣墟
〝这就是你所谓的收获？〞【星】在看完原住民npc势力的应对以后，淡淡地问道。
沐云笑了笑，缓缓地将茶杯放回案上，说道：〝当然不是。〞
只见沐云手一挥，帝望网络的画面又是一变，然后听见沐云说道：〝正所谓：凝视深渊的同时，深渊也凝视着你。在经过这些年的接触以后，玩家们越来越了解原住民npc的同时，原住民npc也越来越清楚玩家们的秉性。〞
〝用高额的奖励和万众瞩目的排名做噱头，轻而易举地将大多数玩家钓成了翘嘴，让玩家们为其所用。〞
〝此举，既缓解了原住民npc势力此时在人力和物力等方面的压力，也能从玩家们的整体表现，大致看出哪些人可以拉拢，哪些人需要进一步打压，借此分化玩家们的力量。〞
〝不得不说，他们想得挺美的，做得也算不错。但可惜的是，他们高高在上惯了，还是没有意识到玩家流失的根本原因。〞
〝正常来说，宇宙游戏的新势力开放，需要完成许多任务，从而满足特定的条件以后，才会一个一个地开放，犹如资料片更新那样。〞
〝可我在一开始的时候，就通过剿匪任务和王者御魂争霸赛的举办，强行满足这些条件，造成一次大改版，不仅吸引更多玩家涌入，也让主大陆正统势力对玩家们全面开放。〞
〝决斗位面的布局，巫源道和无尽炼狱的开辟，以及我在海外之地绕这么一大圈所带来的连锁反应，直接促成第二次大改版，使海外势力也跟着对玩家们全面开放。〞
〝这一次大改版的势头，只会比前一次要来得更强。因为玩家们有了再次选择国度的权利。〞
说到这里，沐云不觉又是一笑：〝要是按照正常的发展轨迹，玩家只会降生在最一开始的那几个国家里面，然后随着这些国家的开拓或分裂，一点一点地向外拓展，玩家们也会在这个过程中逐步分流。〞
〝可不管怎么样，最一开始的那几个国家都会是受益最大的。但也因为玩家过于集中的关系，玩家们反而没有太多的选择权，只能任由那些原住民npc拿捏。〞
〝可当我引发第一次大改版，将玩家分散到主大陆的各方势力，那几个国家本应享有的玩家红利，也被削去了一大半。虽然相较于其它国家，他们获得的玩家红利依旧大得让人眼红，可随着这几年的发展下来，也基本被抹平了。〞
〝蓝星的人口总数，差不多一千八百多亿，接近一千九百亿。截至目前，《帝望》的玩家总数差不多在五百亿上下，只占蓝星人口总数的三分之一。〞
〝要是我什么都没做，主大陆这些原住民npc势力所能获得的玩家红利，至少会是现在的三倍。〞
〝为什么我会这么说？因为资源是有限的，玩家汇集的数量越多，竞争压力也就越大。在这个过程中，玩家们越是内卷，原住民npc所能获取的利益也就越大，因为选择权再次转移到他们的手上。〞
〝可现在嘛……嘎嘎嘎！〞沐云说到最后，忍不住爆出一阵得意的怪笑声。
【星】瞥了沐云一眼，似宠溺又似无奈地笑了笑，然后看着帝望网络的画面，说道：〝随着你所谓的第二次大改版，海外势力全面开放，不但新玩家基本上被海外势力瓜分干净，老玩家也有了重新选择的权利。〞
〝他们此前要是肯好好地对待玩家，老玩家哪怕有这个权利和机会，大概率还是会因为舍不得放弃既有的资产和底蕴而留下。〞

〝可问题是，他们对玩家并没有多好，许多老玩家甚至因为被各种打压的关系，死亡复活太多次，导致气运大量流失，资质提升不上去，亦或因为原住民npc垄断情报与刻意误导的缘故，没有积累太多的底蕴便进行转生，导致其发展的潜力被平白消耗掉。〞
〝所以，那些混得比较差的老玩家，有很大的概率趁着这次的大改版，跟着跑到海外势力那边从头发展。〞
〝很显然，这不是原住民npc能够轻易挽回的。只要他们还抱着打压玩家的想法，距离这些老玩家前去海外势力发展，就只是时间早晚的问题。〞
〝你这已经不是在挖他们的墙角，而是连同他们的根基都给掏空了啊！〞
沐云闻言摊了摊手，说道：〝路是自己选的，能怪谁？〞
〝自己不当人就算了，还跟那些败类同流合污，他们不死谁死？〞
〝正所谓：天作孽，犹可违；自作孽，不可活。他们自己做的孽，凭什么要其他人来帮他们承担？〞
〝什么叫做：天之道，损有余而补不足；人之道，损不足而奉有余？这句话在客观阐述现实规律的同时，也在告诫后人：天道是自动平衡机制。既然人道违背天道，最终必遭天道反噬，人应顺应天道，克制干预欲望。〞
〝用另一个角度对这段话进行解读，其实就是在讲【平衡】二字。什么叫做物极必反？什么叫做过犹不及？自然的规律就摆在那里，不管你接受还是不接受。〞
〝可他们是怎么做的？选择断章取义，把【人之道，损不足以奉有余】奉为圭臬，企图通过层层垄断和剥削，永远高高在上。〞
〝天道的刀就摆在那里，我只是把它给架了出来，仅此而已。〞
【星】闻言摇了摇头，但也没有多说什么，只是看着帝望网络的画面，为那些倒霉蛋默哀。
道理虽是这个道理，但最主要还是因为某人想找乐子。
【星】很清楚，沐云之所以这么做，虽然很大程度是为了让玩家尽可能地摆脱原住民npc的限制，但也有沐云看某些人不顺眼，想让他们倒霉的用意在里面。
这小子虽然表面上看起来人畜无害，可实际上却是芝麻汤圆，白切黑的那种。
谁惹到他头上，谁就等着出乐子了！
就在这时，帝望网络的画面从苏特兰格王国和兰巴米基塔公国等势力闪过，只见玩家成片成片地消失，原本还算热闹的城镇，转眼间就变得冷清……
content_en:
holy market
"Is this what you call harvest?" [Xing] asked calmly after seeing the response of the indigenous NPC forces.
Mu Yun smiled, slowly put the teacup back on the table, and said, "Of course not."
I saw Mu Yun wave his hand, and the screen of Diwang Network changed again, and then I heard Mu Yun say: "As the saying goes: when you stare into the abyss, the abyss also stares at you. After these years of contact, players have become more and more aware of the aboriginal NPCs, and at the same time, the aboriginal NPCs have become more and more aware of the nature of the players."
"Using high rewards and highly anticipated rankings as gimmicks, it is easy to trick most players into turning their mouths and allowing them to take advantage of them."
"This move not only relieves the pressure on the indigenous NPC forces in terms of manpower and material resources at this time, but also allows us to roughly see from the overall performance of the players who can win over and who needs to be further suppressed, thereby dividing the players' power."
"I have to say that they had a beautiful idea and did a pretty good job. But it's a pity that they are used to being aloof and still don't realize the root cause of player loss."
"Normally, the opening of new forces in space games requires the completion of many tasks and meeting specific conditions before they are opened one by one, just like an expansion pack update."
"But from the beginning, I forcibly met these conditions through the bandit suppression mission and the holding of the King's Soul Contest, resulting in a major revision, which not only attracted more players to come in, but also made the main continent's orthodox forces fully open to players."
"The layout of the Duel Plane, the opening of Wuyuan Dao and Endless Purgatory, and the chain reaction brought about by me making such a large circle in overseas places directly contributed to the second major revision, making overseas forces fully open to players."
"The momentum of this major revision will only be stronger than the previous one. Because players have the right to choose their country again."
At this point, Mu Yun unconsciously smiled again: "If we follow the normal development trajectory, players will only be born in the first few countries, and then as these countries develop or split, they will expand outward bit by bit, and players will gradually be divided in this process."
"No matter what, the first few countries will benefit the most. But also because the players are too concentrated, the players don't have much choice and can only let the indigenous NPCs decide."
"But when I triggered the first major revision and dispersed players to various forces on the main continent, more than half of the player bonuses that those countries should have enjoyed were cut off. Although compared to other countries, the player bonuses they received were still enviably large, but with the development of the past few years, they have basically been smoothed out."
"The total population of Blue Star is more than 180 billion, close to 190 billion. As of now, the total number of players of "Emperor's Hope" is around 50 billion, which only accounts for one-third of the total population of Blue Star."
"If I had done nothing, the player bonuses that these indigenous NPC forces in the main continent would have received would have been at least three times what they are now."
"Why do I say this? Because resources are limited, the more players gather, the greater the competitive pressure. In this process, the more players are involved, the greater the benefits that the indigenous NPCs can obtain, because the choice is once again transferred to their hands."
"But now... quack quack!" Mu Yun said at the end, and couldn't help bursting into a proud and weird laugh.
[Xing] glanced at Mu Yun, smiled fondly and helplessly, then looked at the screen of Diwang Network and said: "With what you call the second major revision, overseas forces are fully open. Not only are new players basically divided by overseas forces, but old players also have the right to choose again."
"If they had been willing to treat the players well before, even if the old players had the rights and opportunities, they would most likely stay because they were reluctant to give up their existing assets and heritage. "
"But the problem is that they are not very kind to the players. Many old players have even died and been resurrected too many times due to various suppressions, resulting in a large loss of luck and the inability to improve their qualifications. Or, because of the monopoly of information and deliberate misleading by indigenous NPCs, they reincarnated without accumulating much knowledge, causing their development potential to be wasted. "
"Therefore, there is a high probability that those old players who have not done well will take advantage of this major revision to follow overseas forces and develop from scratch. "
"Obviously, this cannot be easily undone by the indigenous NPCs. As long as they still have the idea of ​​​​suppressing players, it will only be a matter of time before these old players go to develop overseas forces. "
"You are no longer poaching their corners, but you are also hollowing out their foundation!" "
Hearing this, Mu Yun spread his hands and said, "You chose your own path, who can you blame?" "
"Even if you don't deserve to be a human being, you still collude with those scum. If they don't die, who will die?" "
"As the saying goes: If God does evil, you can still disobey it; if you do evil yourself, you will not live. Why should others bear the sins they have done themselves? "
"What does it mean: the way of heaven is to make up for the deficiency when there is excess damage; the way of man is to make up for the deficiency when there is excess damage; the way of man is to make up for the deficiency when there is excess damage?" While this sentence objectively explains the laws of reality, it also warns future generations: The way of heaven is an automatic balancing mechanism. Since the way of humanity violates the way of heaven, it will eventually be counterattacked by the way of heaven. People should comply with the way of heaven and restrain their desire to interfere. "
"Interpreting this passage from another angle is actually talking about the word "balance". What does it mean that everything must be reversed? What does it mean to go too far? The laws of nature are there, whether you accept them or not. "
"But how did they do it? They choose to take it out of context and regard "the way of man, the loss is not enough but the reward is more than enough" as a guideline, trying to stay aloof through layers of monopoly and exploitation. "
"The sword of Tiandao is right there, I just took it out, that's all." "
[Xing] heard this and shook his head, but didn't say much. He just looked at the screen of Diwang Network and mourned for those unlucky ones.
Although the truth is this, the main reason is because someone wants to have fun.
[Xing] It is very clear that the reason why Mu Yun did this was to allow players to get rid of the restrictions of aboriginal NPCs as much as possible, but Mu Yun also had the intention of not liking some people and wanting them to suffer misfortune.
Although this kid looks harmless on the surface, he is actually a sesame glutinous rice dumpling, the white and black kind.
Whoever messes with him will have fun!
At this moment, the images of Diwang Network flashed from the Kingdom of Sutlange and the Principality of Lamba Mikita, and players were seen disappearing in droves. Towns that were originally lively became deserted in the blink of an eye...
